note: Curated candidates for the Expert (GitHub) edition only. Downloading and installing these is not available in the Play build: fetching executable code from a non-Play source is prohibited by the Device and Network Abuse policy (docs/distribution.md 2.1, D1). The Play build may list them for reference, and first-party plugins may be bundled in the APK instead. M14 re-checked every entry after finding the fetcher broken: it passed browser URLs to an endpoint expecting owner/name slugs, so every GitHub fallback 404'd and 24 of 35 entries were recorded as 'could not be fetched'. All 35 fetch. Statuses here come from tools/plugin-compat/run_catalog.py against CPython 3.14 with Beancount 3.2.3; entries carrying tested.on_device were additionally loaded on an Android device.

status_meaning.supported: install, import, execute and round-trip all passed on a real run
status_meaning.needs-config: works, but the plugin directive must carry a configuration string
status_meaning.partial: some steps passed; the failing step is recorded in `tested.reason`
status_meaning.unsupported: a step failed; the reason is recorded
status_meaning.unavailable: could not be fetched or contains no loadable plugin; nothing was run
status_meaning.untested: listed only; no compatibility claim is made
status_meaning.library: not loaded by a plugin directive: a module other code imports, or a command-line tool. Judged on whether it imports and runs, not on a ledger round-trip
status_meaning.beancount-importer: a beangulp/ingest importer rather than a plugin; the app has no importer runner yet
